title: Spacing
description: Margin, padding, and gap utilities on a 0–5 scale, plus directional, axis, responsive, !important, and arbitrary-value variants. See the dedicated Spacing page for full details.

title: Display
description: Control an element's display type — named values, responsive variants, and print-only overrides. See the dedicated Display page for full details.

title: Flexbox
description: Flex container and item utilities — direction, wrap, justify/align, order, grow/shrink. See the dedicated Flexbox page for full details, including which classes don't get responsive variants.

title: Grid
description: A 12-column responsive grid system with containers, rows, columns, offsets, row-cols, and gutters. See the dedicated Grid page for full details.

title: Sizing
description: Width and height utilities, including max/min constraints and viewport units. See the dedicated Sizing page for full details.

title: Typography
description: Text alignment, case, weight, style, line-height, wrapping, and link utilities. See the dedicated Typography page for full details.

title: Colors
description: Text and background color utilities across the semantic palette, plus subtle variants. See the dedicated Colors page for full details.

title: Borders
description: Border presence, direction, width, color, and radius. See the dedicated Borders page for full details.

title: Shadows
description: Box-shadow utilities on a 4-step scale, plus arbitrary values — all responsive. No named !important variant exists for this group (use the arbitrary form: !shadow-[...]). Demos below start from a borderless box — the shared preview component's own baked-in 1px border otherwise draws a hard edge that drowns out a soft shadow, especially shadow-sm and the shadow-none baseline.

title: Position
description: Positioning scheme, offsets, and sticky/fixed helpers, including centering utilities. See the dedicated Position page for full details.

title: Overflow
description: Overflow behavior on both axes and combined — all responsive. Only the combined overflow-* form has a named !important variant (!overflow-hidden); overflow-x-*/overflow-y-* don't.

title: Opacity & Visibility
description: Opacity scale and visibility helpers, including breakpoint show/hide. opacity-*/visible/invisible all have a named !important variant; the responsive forms don't combine with !important.

title: Misc
description: Cursor, z-index, pointer events, user select, and float utilities. See the dedicated Misc page for full details, including a responsive float form most references skip.

title: Arbitrary Values
description: Any utility not covered by a named class can be expressed with square brackets. See the dedicated Arbitrary Values page for the complete reference of which prefixes support responsive breakpoints and !important.
